title: AttributeData Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for AttributeData values, covering the object that stores a specific attribute value for a primitive, point, or vertex.
guidance: Use this article when generated Python needs a specific geometric attribute value rather than the Attribute metadata object.
Read val for the stored attribute value; the returned type depends on the attribute and may be a float, int, string, tuple, Position, or Vector.
Normal attribute data is represented as a Vector, while position attribute data is represented as a Position.
Do not invent class-specific methods for AttributeData; the official page lists no operator specific methods.
